display_long_description:
BRAVE TV offers the best global MMA, Martial Arts and Entertainment experience to its fans.


Enjoy MMA Fighting and other martial arts content along with interviews, podcasts, documentaries and more with BRAVE TV, some content is FREE to WATCH and some at a very affordable subscription in your region.


New events and programming updated on a monthly basis from BRAVE TV and partner events, never leaves a dull moment for the fans of the sport


Videos

Watch captivating fights with nail biting finishes , video highlights, document series, event trailers, training videos and more


Subscribe Now

Get full access to fights & more on BRAVE TV now at your fingertips.


Live Events

Free access to selected BRAVE TV and Partnered events, press conferences, fighter interviews, weigh ins, behind the scenes in real-time


Don't forget to turn on Notifications

Stay connected by receiving event reminders, groundbreaking announcements, and live streaming notifications right as they happen.


Athletes

Check out your favorite heroes in the cage on their journey to success


BRAVE Gyms

Training the mind, body and spirit. BRAVE gym offers state of the art equipment and traditional fitness options to personnel training. A full range of youth and group fitness programs and MMA instructions in the BRAVE cage.


BRAVE Combat Federation has been on a mission to showcase young and experienced Martial Arts talent on a global stage, to tell the story of their struggle.
